# Esme & Jade

> Handmade healing crystal bead bracelets, cleansed and energetically charged with intention. Created by Christina Workman, Certified Reiki Master and Ordained Minister.

## About

Esme & Jade creates handmade healing crystal bead bracelets. Every bracelet is made with genuine crystal beads — never glass or plastic imitations. Each piece is handpicked, hand-beaded, and goes through a multi-day process of cleansing and energetic charging before shipping.

Founded by Christina Workman, a Certified Reiki Master with over 20 years of experience and Ordained Minister.

## Products

- **Healing Crystal Bracelets**: Handmade with genuine crystal beads on stretchy elastic cord
- **Available Crystals**: Amethyst, Rose Quartz, Tiger's Eye, Clear Quartz, Black Tourmaline, Citrine, Lapis Lazuli, Jade, and more
- **Custom Bracelets**: Request a custom bracelet with your preferred crystals or intention

## Crystal Properties

- Amethyst — Calm, Intuition, Spiritual Growth
- Rose Quartz — Love, Compassion, Emotional Healing
- Tiger's Eye — Courage, Confidence, Protection
- Clear Quartz — Clarity, Amplification, Energy
- Black Tourmaline — Protection, Grounding, Shield
- Citrine — Abundance, Joy, Manifestation
- Lapis Lazuli — Wisdom, Truth, Self-Awareness
- Jade — Harmony, Luck, Prosperity
